answer: Where did the cipher come from? Who painted the hollow? When was the vault finished? The farm answers the first two and chokes on the third. The door takes payment, not promises: the farm pays 19630 POA while one agent pays 130. Every applicant faces the same trial, Kiln stoker rose pink warrant glazed at the mould loft, and every verdict reads the same way: each rose pink is a measured clay yield plus a tiler's signature. The ledger answers every claim yes or no, and no one has ever talked it out of an answer. The farm tried to buy the epoch and found the epoch is not for sale.
